set.body:
Owner 2026-10-24: "tracker seems important. we can defer tracker, but not forget." Deferred out of S3c.
Build a track-level visual source for Sherlock (local person/face detection plus PySceneDetect shot cuts, at least over part-2 84-290 s, then the whole film), emitting EvidenceAnchor.Track mentions and per-track observed coverage (ReferentContext trackCoverage) so ContinuousTrack and SimultaneousTracks identity bases become available. Acceptance: per-basis precision against frozen independent labels on a few dozen pairs (S3b finding: sampled frame pairs are contributory AppearanceMatch only); shot cuts break continuity; receipts for model and binary pins. Needs disk headroom; decide bd-01M5NE6F401JA5Q2FGDJD8PDC0 (threshold floor) before any detector-based PresenceClaim.
set.title: [evidence-binding] Track-level visual source for Sherlock (deferred from S3c)
